_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
name: CS2 Ptero Egg
author: paslaugos.rampage@gmail.com
description: The SteamRT3 Platform image for Pterodactyl & Pelican CS2 servers is packed with numerous features, designed to simplify server management and reduce hassle.

variables.name: Prefix Text
variables.description: Custom text for console prefix. Default: CS2

variables.name: Allow Tokenless Servers
variables.description: Internal setting to allow servers to run without GSLT token.

variables.name: Source AppID
variables.description: NOT VISIBLE TO USERS. DO NOT EDIT.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum number of players the server can host.

variables.name: Disable Updates
variables.description: Set to 1 to stop updates.

variables.name: Validate Install
variables.description: Toggles SteamCMD validation of game server files. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: The Steam Game Server Login Token (GSLT) used to publicly list your server. Optional, but recommended for increased visibility and access to additional features. Learn more: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The default map for the server.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Paired with Game Mode to pick the CS2 mode. 0 + 0 = Casual, 0 + 1 = Competitive, 0 + 2 = Wingman, 1 + 0 = Arms Race, 1 + 1 = Demolition, 1 + 2 = Deathmatch, 2 + 0 = Custom, 3 + 0 = Guardian, 4 + 0 = Danger Zone.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Second half of the mode pair — see Game Type for the combinations.

variables.name: MetaMod:Source
variables.description: Base plugin framework required by CounterStrikeSharp. Compatible with all frameworks. Auto-enabled if CSS is selected. Automatically updates on server restart while enabled.

variables.name: CounterStrikeSharp
variables.description: C# scripting platform for CS2 plugins with .NET 10 runtime. Requires MetaMod:Source (auto-enabled). Compatible with SwiftlyS2. Incompatible with ModSharp. Automatically updates on server restart while enabled.

variables.name: SwiftlyS2
variables.description: C# framework for Source Engine 2 servers with .NET 10 runtime. MetaMod is optional, not required. Runs alongside CounterStrikeSharp. Conflicts with ModSharp. Automatically updates on server restart while enabled.

variables.name: ModSharp
variables.description: Standalone C# scripting platform with .NET 10 runtime. Compatible with MetaMod only. Conflicts with CSS and SwiftlyS2 — enabling them together only logs a warning, nothing is disabled for you. Automatically updates on server restart while enabled.

variables.name: Allow Prerelease Updates
variables.description: Allow downloading prerelease/beta versions of frameworks (CSS, SwiftlyS2, ModSharp) from GitHub. Warning: Prereleases may be unstable.

variables.name: Console Filter
variables.description: Filter unwanted console messages. Configure filter patterns in /home/container/egg/configs/console-filter.json

variables.name: Custom Parameters
variables.description: Custom startup parameters to add to the command line.

variables.name: Auto Cleanup
variables.description: Automatically cleans up old logs, demos, and backup files. Configure cleanup intervals in /home/container/egg/configs/cleanup.json

variables.name: GDB Remote Debug Port
variables.description: GDB remote debugging port for IDA. Specify port number (e.g., 27130) and allocate it in network settings. Connect: IDA → Debugger → Remote GDB debugger. Performance impact: ~5-10%. Leave empty to disable. Development only!

variables.name: Daemon Wait Timeout (s)
variables.description: How long the container waits for the VPK daemon to finish pushing game files before falling through to SteamCMD. Increase if you see cfg files getting wiped after morning update restarts on hosts with many CS2 servers. Default 180s covers ~30 servers on the same host.
